args.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS classification,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000)) AS avg_bfr,
    STDDEV(sp.anomscore) AS stddev_anomaly
FROM signals s
JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END
ORDER BY classification;

SELECT 
    sp.techsigprob, sp.natsrcprob, sp.sigunique, sp.anomscore,
    sp.techsigprob * (1 - sp.natsrcprob) * sp.sigunique * (0.5 + sp.anomscore / 10) AS tols_score
FROM signalprobabilities sp
ORDER BY tols_score DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT bwhz, centerfreqmhz, bwhz / (centerfreqmhz * 1000000) AS bfr FROM signals LIMIT 5;
